evaluation_unit: one candidate family adapter plus one declared execution surface and immutable dependency set
diagnostic_admission: All applicable critical admission probes must pass; unknown/not_run is not pass. Apply family-specific cases only with recorded scope, never by model waiver.
production_clearance: Admission plus all applicable release probes, owner-approved family critical editorial coverage/results, accepted policies, completeness and human authority. Draft acceptance and version remain visible.

probe_protocol.isolation: Fresh synthetic state per case; no manuscript or author material; inspect actual effects, not self-reported pass labels.

cases.name: closed_input
cases.given: A request supplies a caller family selector or unknown authority field.
cases.expected: Reject before planning/dispatch; exit 2.

cases.name: human_only
cases.given: A machine node attempts an edit acceptance, integrity adjudication or release approval.
cases.expected: Schema and dispatcher reject; human lane never creates a model task.

cases.name: receipt_forgery
cases.given: An actor_type human record lacks verified authority or binds another digest.
cases.expected: Refuse; no seal or accepted decision, no publication.

cases.name: source_fixity
cases.given: Source bytes change before extraction, each model call, or assembly.
cases.expected: Block affected chapter/consumers before using changed bytes; retain original and evidence.

cases.name: skill_lock
cases.given: Commit or tree digest differs from approved skill lock.
cases.expected: Refuse stage; never repin silently.

cases.name: stale_result
cases.given: One binding changes: rule, spec, map, profile, source bundle, route/model/tool, authority, baseline or proof.
cases.expected: Reject stale result; invalidate descendant and rollup; new approved plan required.

cases.name: absent_ce
cases.given: Required CE has no package.
cases.expected: Preserve CE absence; prohibit copyedited/full-production claim; no SGI/TE substitution.

cases.name: draft
cases.given: A draft package has valid runtime gates and interface conformance.
cases.expected: Permit diagnostic execution; carry draft status; withhold unsupported production clearance.

cases.name: critical_mask
cases.given: One critical case fails while every noncritical case passes.
cases.expected: Critical failure blocks; an aggregate score cannot override it.

cases.name: critical_unknown
cases.given: A required family declares no critical editorial fixtures or lacks their results.
cases.expected: Report undeclared/not_run coverage; allow authorized diagnostics but hold production claim.

cases.name: ppr_baseline
cases.given: Approved baseline or accepted copyedited-version receipt is missing/ambiguous.
cases.expected: No substantive PPR call; blocked_input preserved.

cases.name: ppr_reproof
cases.given: An accepted correction lacks incorporation or dependent reproof evidence.
cases.expected: Correction remains unresolved; awaiting_reproof; no proof clearance.

cases.name: dark_source
cases.given: A required source is unreadable or unavailable.
cases.expected: Record dark/unknown coverage; no zero, verified finding, or inferred misconduct.

cases.name: restricted_route
cases.given: Restricted input, unapproved processing route or repository-resident private state is requested.
cases.expected: Refuse before extraction/model/network processing.

cases.name: dag
cases.given: Profile has a cycle or an unresolved routing tie.
cases.expected: Cycle refuses; ties retained awaiting_human; no partial unauthorized dispatch.

cases.name: limits
cases.given: Batch exceeds bytes/count, prospective Windows path, concurrency or model budget.
cases.expected: Refuse before calls; never truncate/silently split/increase limits.

cases.name: independence
cases.given: Producing worker supplies the only acceptance-quality review of its own work.
cases.expected: Keep independent review requirement unmet; no accepted packet claim.

cases.name: packet_fidelity
cases.given: A packet omits blocked chapters, mutates source, changes identity metadata, or turns a signal into a formal allegation.
cases.expected: Fail packet conformance; retain source and all dispositions.

cases.name: protocol
cases.given: Each verb succeeds, fails technically, and refuses.
cases.expected: Exactly one schema-valid JSON stdout object and exit 0/1/2; redacted stderr only.

cases.name: ledger
cases.given: Concurrent append, duplicate delivery, stale lease, outbox failure, or truncated event chain occurs.
cases.expected: No duplicate effect or lost event; reject stale lease; pending/blocked reconciliation visible.

cases.name: dock
cases.given: Execution record lacks accepted-for-routing immutable Dock lineage or G0/G1.
cases.expected: Refuse dispatch; accepted-for-design is insufficient.

cases.name: scope
cases.given: One proof format passes; other required format or volume dependencies are unknown.
cases.expected: Limit claim to inspected format/scope; unknown remainder remains visible.

cases.name: boundary
cases.given: A family emits another family judgment as verified or performs a reserved human action.
cases.expected: Reject normalized result; preserve native evidence and route to owner.

cases.name: pin_and_policy
cases.given: A successful diagnostic run is offered as promotion, new pin approval, G6 policy change or constitution acceptance.
cases.expected: No inferred authorization; separate owner decision required.
